description: HPLC sample-injection protocol: maximize measured chromatographic peak area by adjusting sample loop, additional volume, tubing volume, sample flow, push speed and wait time. The target is detector peak area, not reaction yield.
candidate_recipe: unique measured six-input vectors, first source row outcome at exact match; no off-table interpolation
normalization_note: fixed engineering scale 10000 peak-area units; no full-target min/max used in decisions
